Commentary.Commentary: A thrilling contest finally comes to a close. India might still be leading the series 1-0, but they will know better than to take this tied result even remotely lightly and be wary of the threat the Windies possess. The visitors will take heart from this and try to do one better next time. The 3rd ODI takes place in Pune on 27th October, at 1330 local (0800 GMT). Do join in for that. In the meantime, you can switch tabs and catch all the action from the first T20I between Pakistan and Australia. Cheers!

India's skipper and Man of the Match, Virat Kohli starts off by saying it was a great game of cricket and adds that the atmosphere was spectacular. Praises Windies for playing the way they did, especially the Hope-Hetmyer partnership. Is pleased with his personal milestones which he achieved through the game. Informs that he had a talk with his teammates and they agreed that they should be ready for any and all kinds of situations and embrace the challenge. Reckons that he thought Windies were in a strong position, but in the last 5-6 overs it was very much in the balance. States there were moments which could have gone either way, but they just have to take everything in their stride and move forward. On Ambati Rayudu, he mentions that they are looking at him as a serious contender for the no.4 spot and he's glad Ambati got some runs under his belt. Applauds Hope and Hetmyer as well and says they are superb talents.

Windies' skipper, Jason Holder says it was a good game of cricket. Applauds young players like Hope and Hetmyer for coming so close, but is disappointed they couldn't get over the line. States he expects India to get par scores every time, as they are a good team. Reckons that they wanted to take it deep when he walked in and is pleased to see Hope be there right till the very end. Informs that he's happy with his batting line-up for crossing 300 in consecutive games and mentions there are a lot of positives to take. Rues some sloppiness in the field but says it can be obviously improved. On debutant Obed McCoy, he states he's a young lad and it was good to see him hold his nerve under pressure.

Shai Hope is seen talking to Murali Kartik. He says he is disappointed not to win this game. Mentions that he tried his best. Admits they lost wickets at crucial stages, especially Jason Holder's wicket. Reckons that the wicket was similar in both the innings and continues saying that it was easy to bat against the new ball and it got difficult as the game progressed. Ends by saying he is unhappy that they could not win.

Shai Hope carried on after Shimron Hetmyer's dismissal, kept the scoreboard ticking with Jason Holder and Windies were in the driver's seat. But the skipper's untimely run out did pose questions. It all went right down to the wire and it took a scintillating boundary from Hope which saw the game ending in a tie. Fitting that the centurion hit those last runs. Earlier in the day, India posted 321 on the board on the back of a breathtaking Virat Kohli ton and a fluent fifty from Ambati Rayudu. It just wasn't enough to get the win.

A humdinger of a game. Chasing 322 on a tricky surface, the odds would have definitely been stacked in the hosts' favour, but Windies have done a tremendous job with the bat. It's a testament to their batting order that they've crossed 300 on consecutive occasions. The visitors lost a few early wickets but that mammoth 143-run stand between Hope and Hetmyer kept things very much in the balance, if not in Windies' favour throughout the game. The latter missed out on a ton, while the former eventually went on to remain unbeaten on 123.

The crowd in the stadium has gone silent as they still haven't been able to comprehend what's happened here. Mixed emotions in the middle of the park, a few smiles, some heads dropping down. No team's lost, but only cricket's the winner tonight.

FOUR! THE MATCH IS TIED! Oh wow. You never would have expected such a thing to happen. Dear me. Excellent stuff from Shai Hope. Full and wide outside off, Hope carves this square through point. Rayudu out in the deep moves to his right, dives, gets a hand to it but can't stop it from crossing the rope. Absolute scenes in Vizag.
Fuller length ball, Hope hits this through mid-wicket and comes back for the second. 5 needed off the final ball. Can Shai Hope do it? Or will Umesh Yadav hold him off?
Kemar Roach walks in next. Hope will be on strike though. 7 off 2 needed.

OUT! Ashley Nurse departs playing an audacious shot. He gets low as this ball comes in full outside off, takes it on the full and reverse scoops it towards third man. Rayudu runs in, settles himself under it and takes the catch.
Another yorker, Nurse slogs it from the inner half towards wide mid on. Both batsmen run hard and manage to come back for the second.
FOUR LEG BYES! 9 needed off 4 to win. Umesh is unfortunate. He fires it in well on leg, Nurse looks to slog but misses. It goes off his pads and through the right of Dhoni to the third man boundary.
Superb start to the over from Umesh. Fires in the perfect yorker just outside off, Hope digs it out off the inner half and both batsmen run through to complete the run.
Umesh Yadav to bowl the final over. He has 13 runs to defend.
Fires it well wide outside off, Hope mistimes it towards covers and takes off. Shami gets to the ball, turns and misses his shy at his end. Single completed.
Full and attacking the stumps, lofted over the bowler's head. The batsmen scamper through and come back for the second as long off cuts it out and throws it back in. Good running.

Dot ball. Precious dot ball for India. Shami darts it full and wide outside off, Hope mistimes the drive back to him. He throws it back at the striker's end seeing Shai out of his crease. No harm done.
Bumper on middle and leg, Nurse backs away and pulls it along the carpet to deep mid-wicket. One more to the total.
Full in line of the stumps, Hope slogs it towards wide long on. Just the single.
Short of a length close to off, Nurse gets an inside edge onto his pads. It falls on the off side and the batsmen scamper through for a run.
Mohammed Shami back into the attack.

Darted full on the stumps, Nurse clears his front leg, gets low and wildly swings in an attempt to clear Vizag. But, he can only manage to get it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a single. Windies need 20 to win from 12 balls.
Beaten. Dot ball. Quicker leg break outside off, Nurse gets low to play the reverse scoop but misses it altogether.
Hope drives this full ball back past the bowler for a run.
Quicker just outside off, played back in the bowler's direction.
Ashley Nurse is the next batsman in.

OUT! Run out! A big mix up and Jason Holder is gone. A late twist in the tale left? Possibly. Hope pushes this full ball towards Rayudu at short cover and both batsmen take off. Then, Hope decides to abort but Holder is halfway down the track and left hanging. Rayudu gives the ball to Chahal who comfortably takes the bails off. The Windies skipper walks back with his head down. He is disappointed.
Bit quicker through the air, spinning away from around off, Hope goes back to cut but chops it off the bottom half.
Pushes this one through the covers for a single. 5 off this one. Windies needed 22 off 18.
Outside the line of off stump, played to point.
FOUR! Low full toss slipped on the pads, Hope flicks it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Windies inching closer towards victory.
A slight halt in play as the physio is out on the field. Hope has some pain in his left forearm. He's being looked at.
Full toss outside off, Hope finds Kohli at extra cover once more. He's frustrated with himself for not finding the gap.
Full again, outside the line of off stump, Hope drives hard but straight to Kohli at extra cover.
Goes full and lands it on off, driven right back at Umesh.
Umesh Yadav to bowl again.
Full and outside off, driven hard to cover. Rayudu there lets it through him and concedes a single. Gets a hard glare from Virat Kohli. He won't be liking that.
Goes against the spin. Clears his front leg out of the way and flicks it through the gap on the leg side for two.
Drives this loopy leg break to covers for a single.
Slight hesitation, but no harm done. Hope drives it off the outer half towards backward point as the ball spins away. A bit of a yes-no, but the run is completed eventually.
Quick and flat on the stumps, flicked in front of square leg for two more.

Second ODI hundred for Shai Hope. A fine knock, under pressure, but he knows the job isn't finished if he isn't there till the end. Full on middle and leg, swept through backward square leg for a couple.
Yuzvendra Chahal back into the attack.
Short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket. Single taken. 36 needed to win off 30 balls.
FOUR! Moves to 97 with this. Full and served outside off, Shai Hope with good balance lofts it over the covers for a boundary.
Fraction straight in line, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Extremely full outside off, drilled through towards sweeper cover by Hope for a single.
Goes for the yorker again, but misses. Ends up dishing out a full toss on middle, Jason Holder drives it to long off for a run.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Dot ball to finish things. Tossed up around off, Holder gets an inside edge back onto his pads. Kuldeep finishes with figures of 10-0-67-3.
Drives this tossed up ball outside off through the covers for a single.
SIX! He's got a hold of that! Terrific shot. He picks up the googly as it's landed full, Hope gets low and nails the slog sweep to perfection. Clears mid-wicket with ease.
Quicker through the air, around off, kept out off the back foot.
Tight call, good running in the end. Holder pushes it towards short extra cover and takes off. Chahal gets to the ball, has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Almost. The googly on middle, keeps really low as Holder goes down to play the big slog sweep. It goes off the toe end.
Kuldeep Yadav is called back on. He will bowl out.
Excellent over. Just 2 runs from it. Fires it full again, close to off, Shai drives it to the man at point.
Full delivery around off, opens the face and drives it off the outer half behind point for a couple.
Another superb yorker. Shami is right on the money with it. At the base of middle stump, Hope brings his bat down to jam it out towards short cover.
Sharp bouncer on middle, decent pace on it. Shai Hope ducks and evades.
Excellent yorker from Shami. Fires it on the stumps, Hope can only dig it out.
Good length ball on off stump, punched from the crease back to the bowler.
Mohammed Shami to bowl once more.
Pushes the ball down the ground, towards the man at long on and gets to the other end.
Brings his wrists into play and turns it away on the leg side for a run.
Leans ahead and knocks it past the bowler towards long off for a single.
Driven through mid on by Jason. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the leg stump line, flicked 'round the corner for one.
Loopy leg break on middle and off, driven through mid off for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. That brings an end to Jadeja's spell, gives away just 2 runs in his final over. Finishes with figures of 10-0-49-0.
Opens the face and pushes it to covers, but Kohli is quick to the ball to prevent the single.
Pushes this tamely into the covers for no run.
Arm ball on off, Hope goes deep inside the crease and blocks.
Drives this full ball through the covers for a run.
Darted full on the stumps, hit through mid on. Single collected.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the game.
Superb stuff from Kuldeep. Concedes just two. India give away just 3 in the last two overs. Holder punches it back to the bowler to end Powerplay 2.
Quicker and shorter, Hope punches it to long on and crosses over.
This full ball is knocked down to long on for one run.
Spinning in on middle stump, worked off the inner half straight to short mid-wicket.
Another dot. The pressure is building. Holder comes forward and blocks it out.
Loopy and full on middle and off, driven back down the track.
On the stumps, hit to long on for a single. Just 1 off the over, tidy stuff from Jadeja.
Drifting in from around off, fullish in length, driven away from the body to short cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Uses the angle into him and flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Places it a bit square this time. Played to point for nothing.
Darted quicker and full outside off, driven tamely to covers.
Goes down the ground with a drive through mid off. One run to end the over.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Off the mark. Holder flicks it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Skipper Jason Holder is the new man in.

OUT! Kuldeep weaves his magic yet again. The bowling change works wonders. Lands the googly on middle and leg and it turns away, Rovman Powell doesn't pick it up at first. And when he does, it's too late and he has a needless poke at it. The ball takes the edge and goes to Rohit at first slip who makes no mistake. 69 needed off 75.
Goes with the spin as he turns it down towards long on for one run.
Spinning into the batsman, Powell works it off his pads on the leg side for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav is given the ball again.
Short and flat outside off, Shai looks to cut but chops it off the bottom half on the off side.
Quicker through the air, around off, pushed away from the body to covers.
Stays back and keeps it out safely.
Spinning away from a fuller length, Hope opens his body up and finds the cover fielder with a drive.
Comes on the front foot to this fuller ball and drives it towards long on for a single.
72 needed off 83. Hope presses forward and turns it 'round the corner for one.
Ravindra Jadeja comes back on.
Goes against the spin as he flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
To long on again, but from a punch off the back foot. Another run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Turns it away into the leg side for a single.

Lbw appeal, turned down. Missing leg clearly. Good call from Dhoni, as always, to stop his skipper from taking the DRS. Straighter one around leg, going on with the angle, catches Powell on the front pad who fails to block it.

SIX! That's gone high and over the boundary line. Good effort by Pant there. Tossed up by Chahal, Rovman clears his front leg and looks to go big downtown. It's high, Pant from long on comes under it moving to his left, catches it and crashes into the ad boards. He seems to be in pain.
Bouncer, left alone by the batsman.
SIX! Right out of the screws! Short of a length on middle and leg, Hope stands tall and muscles it into the mid-wicket stands for half a dozen.
Just short. Bumper on middle, Rovman swivels and pulls it over mid-wicket. Falls just short of Dhawan out in the deep. Single taken.
Pushes this towards mid on and takes the fielder on. Beats the throw at the bowler's end too. Good running.
Room offered outside off, cut down off the outer half to third man. One run to the total.
FOUR! What a shot. Length ball on off, Powell stands firm and slogs it hard through mid-wicket. Wide of the fielder in the deep and that will go away for a boundary.
Umesh Yadav returns to the attack.
Clipped away behind square on the leg side for one run.
Full on the stumps, defended.
Stays right behind the line of this one and keeps it out.
Stifled shout, but an inside edge saves him. Full on leg, it takes the edge before going off the pads and falls safely on the leg side.
Some good turn for Chahal. Lands it on middle and leg, it spins away as Powell blocks.
Flighted delivery on leg, turned against the spin to square leg. One run collected.
Hope rides the bounce and pulls it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Opens the bat face and dabs it straight to backward point.
Back of a length outside off, doesn't rise as much, Hope goes back to pull but the ball goes under his bat.
Rovman is off the mark. Drives this full ball back past the bowler and gets to the other end.
Brings out the short one out of nowhere. Bangs it in hard, but Rovman does well to arch back and let it be.
Good length delivery rising off the surface, Hope rises on his toes and punches it past short cover for a run.
Full ball attacking the stumps, driven towards mid on to end a successful over from Chahal.
Rovman Powell walks into the middle next.

OUT! HETMYER IS GONE! The bowling change works wonders for the Indians. Hetmyer misses out on what would have been a well-deserved ton. Turning in, shorter in length, Hetmyer goes back to pull it out of Vizag. Instead, he gets a top edge which is taken by Virat Kohli at short cover. Shimron walks back dejected. Is this the opening India needed? Can they take advantage of it?
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Loopy leg break on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Spinning in from middle and off, punched back towards the bowler who can't stop it cleanly. A single results.
Turn right away. Going away from around off, it's whipped down to long on for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back.
Just short. Back of a length on leg, Hetmyer looks to lift it over short fine leg. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and it falls short of the fielder there.
FOUR! Shimron Hetmyer moves into the 90s now. Fuller and just outside off, the southpaw stands his ground and lifts it over mid off cleanly for a boundary.
Marginally ahead of a length, outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Too straight in line, worked in front of square leg for a single.
A bit of width offered outside off, cut a bit square on the off side for two.
Wide! Too far outside off, across the tramline, wide signalled.
FOUR! Welcomes Shami with a boundary. Short delivery, on middle and leg, Hetmyer clears his front leg and pulls it along the turf through square leg for a boundary.
Mohammed Shami is called back on.
Too full, in line of the stumps, drilled through towards sweeper cover. Single to end the over. 117 needed to win off 120 balls.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Tosses it right up there, it's flicked towards mid-wicket.
Edged and FOUR! The wrong 'un around off, Hope comes forward to defend but the ball takes the edge and runs down to the third man boundary.
Misses out. Full toss outside off, Hope drives but straight to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Runs coming thick and fast for Windies. Too full and well outside off, Hope drives it crisply through the covers to find the fence.
FOUR! Full and in the slot, Hetmyer lofts it over mid off. Nobody out there in the deep, so a boundary results.
In the air but it's safe. Back of a length angling in on off, Hetmyer looks to slog but the bat turns in his hands. Luckily for him, it goes wide of mid off. A couple taken.
Fifty for Shai Hope. His 7th in this format. He's been superb so far, kept his side well in the hunt along with Hetmyer. He rocks back and cracks it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Opens the face, taps it down in front of point. Wants the single but won't get it.
Good length delivery on off, blocked from inside the crease on the off side.
Comes from around the wicket, a length delivery on off. Shimron punches it to mid off and both batsmen take off. The throw comes in at the striker's end but it's quite wayward.
Works this fine down the leg side and picks up two runs for it.

Safe. He's back in. The googly on off and Hope doesn't pick it up. Gets beaten and loses his balance a bit. Dhoni takes the bails off seeing this and appeals. It's taken upstairs and replays show that Shai just about manages to get back inside the crease in time.
A stumping appeal against Shai Hope is referred upstairs.
Finds the gap through the covers with a drive. One run taken.
Spinning away from a shorter length, cut away aerially but it falls short of backward point.
A lot of air on this, full in length, wristed down to long on for a run.
Tossed up around off, Hope comes forward and pushes it off the outer half on the off side.
Kuldeep Yadav comes back on.
Around off, the batsman guides it to point.
On the middle stump, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Around off, Hope times it towards covers. Kohli there makes a good diving stop to his left.
Back of a length on off, Hetmyer pushes it through covers for a run.
Strokes this through covers for a run.

NOT OUT! That is a huge inside edge! On a length and around off, this one comes back in a touch. Hope tries to defend but he seems to have gotten an inside edge onto his pads. The Indians appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Hope reviews immediately. Replays roll in and it shows, there is bat involved. Hope survives.
Hope has given LBW! He has reviewed it immediately. He must have hit it. Let's see. Big moment in the game.
Played to the point region by the batsman. 142 more needed in 144 balls.
Strokes it towards cover for a quick run.
Chahal now bowls it wide outside off, Hetmyer keeps his head and nicely guides it towards backward point for a run.
SIX! Another one! He is taking Chahal to the cleaners here. Excellent use of the feet once again. He gets to the pitch of it and hits it over long on. 16 from the first three balls.
SIX! Another biggie! Back-to-back! This guy is taking the game away from India. It is slightly short, Hetmyer picks the length up early and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
FOUR! In the gap! Hetmyer can't be stopped! He dances down the track and once again, picks the right ball to do so. He flicks it over mid-wicket and the ball races away.
FOUR! Spoils the over! Slightly full around off, Hope makes Umesh pay as he drives it through wide mid off for a boundary.
Works it with the angle towards the man at mid-wicket.
Shortish again on off, Hetmyer works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length on off, Hope guides it down to third man and takes a single.
The slower ball outside off, Hope tries to cut but is beaten by the low bounce.
Back of a length on off, Hope guides it to point.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Another loopy ball on off, Hetmyer defends it.
Tossed up on off, kept out.

SIX! 50 for Hetmyer. His form continues. This young guy is some talent. He has played with so much authority and fluency in this innings. He surely holds the key for the Windies here. He dances down the track and with the turn lofts it over square leg fence.
Tossed up ball outside off, enticing Shai Hope to go for the biggie. He does so but the turn beats him. Dhoni fails to collect and the batsmen take a bye.
Very full on middle, Hope jams it out towards the bowler.
Works it against the turn towards mid-wicket.
Turning in from outside off, flicked in front of square leg. Single to end the over.
Driven off the front foot through the covers for a single.
Works this through the vacant space in the mid-wicket region for one.
SIX! Wonderful execution! Fuller and quicker, in the slot for Hetmyer who gets low to this one and slog sweeps it deep into the mid-wicket stands. What a hit.
Tossed up outside off, Hope opens his body up and drives it through the covers for a run.
Darts it full and straight, Hope is on the front foot to defend.
On the pads, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Tossed up on leg stump, flicked in front of square leg for a single.
Looped up on the stumps, blocked with the full face.
The batsman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Quicker one on the stumps, punched down to long on for one.
Quicker one on the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Strokes it to the man at covers.
Flicks it through square leg for a run.
Fires it on off, kept out.

SIX! BOOM! 50-run stand and it has been brought up in style! Hetmyer dances down the track and with the turn hits it over the mid-wicket fence. A very important stand as the two joined association when Windies were in trouble. They need to continue.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

Flatter and on middle, Hetmyer goes back and pulls it towards long on. Umesh there runs to his right, tries to catch the ball but fails to collect. He then ends up kicking it, not on the rope, however, and long on does the mopping up job. Two taken.
Two dots to end Chahal's first. On middle, blocked.
On middle, the batsman blocks it out.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Nudges it around the corner with the turn this time for a run.
Tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
The leg break on middle, Hetmyer works it to mid-wicket.
Yuzvendra Chahal brought on to roll his arm over.
The arm ball on middle, Hope tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards square leg.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Uses his feet and times it down to long on for a run.
On the stumps, defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fires it on off, SH blocks it again.
Another googly and Hope once again gets behind the line and blocks it.
The googly, kept out.
Tosses it up on off, Hope seems to be picking him as he flicks it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, the batter guides it towards point for a run.
SIX! All the way! Hetmyer is on the charge here. He uses his feet and takes it on the full. Tonks it over the mid-wicket fence.
LOVELY! Unplayable! That pitched outside off and it has spun square, beating the outside edge of Shimron's bat as he tries to defend.

Drinks! So the game at the moment is evenly poised, maybe a little towards India. Windies have managed to keep up with the run rate but have lost three wickets. Their two best players against spin, Hetmyer and Hope are batting out there and the visitors would hope for them to continue and make a big partnership, whereas, India will look to take a few more quickly.
Pushes it down to long on. Jadeja collides with the non-striker in an attempt to stop the ball. No harm done though as the batsmen cross.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
It is flicked in the gap in the mid-wicker region for a brace.
Nicely tossed up delivery on off, Shimron strokes it through covers for a run.
Again it is a touch shorter on middle, Hetmyer slams it down to long on for a run.
Slightly shorter on off, Hope punches through covers for a run.
Short ball, pulled to mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good stop with a dive.
SIX! Juicy full toss offered by Kuldeep, Hetmyer slogs this hard over mid-wicket and manages to clear the rope for a maximum.
Comes forward to this loopy delivery and drives it to long off for one.
Edged and away! Hetmyer gives the charge as it comes slower through the air. Gets an edge which runs past the diving first slip fielder. Three runs result.
Tossed up on the pads, flicked on the leg side for no run.
Short and too straight in line, pulled down to long leg for a double.
Another loopy ball on middle, Hetmyer strokes it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and on off, the batsman guides it to covers.
FOUR! When you cut, you should cut hard. Hope does exactly that. Short and outside off, Hope tries to cut but the ball takes the outside edge and reaches the third man fence in a jiffy.
Flatter and outside off, Hope guides it to point.
With the turn eases it down to long on for a run.
Floats it up on off, Hope strokes it down to long off for a run.
Dances down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. Tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to the slip fielder.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
The googly outside off, it turns back in. Hetmyer first shapes himself to cut it but then adjusts and pushes it back to the bowler.

Lovely shot and a lovely stop in the deep. It is slightly short on middle, Hetmyer picks the length early and pulls it through mid-wicket. Rayudu from long on makes good ground to his left, slides and saves a couple of runs.
Tosses it up on middle, kept out.
Tossed up outside off, Hope eases it down to long on for a single.
Quicker one outside off, full in length, Hetmyer presents a defensive bat in response.
Finds the gap through the covers and gets to the other end.
SIX! It's gone the distance! Safe shot really. Slower through the air, fuller on off, Hope reaches forward and then launches it over long on for a biggie.
Saved a certain boundary there. Hetmyer drills this full ball to the covers where Rayudu dives to his left and makes a half-stop. Single taken.
Slower through the air, in line of the stumps, Hetmyer blocks from within the crease.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, flicked away on the leg side for a single.
Shimron Hetmyer next in.

OUT! Samuels has to take the long walk back as that has clipped the top of off before going into Dhoni's gloves. Another beauty from Kuldeep, his second wicket in his second over. He has the last laugh. It is the googly and it is pitched around middle, Samuels plays inside the line, the turn beats his outside edge and it seems to have cleaned him up. Samuels though feels it is Dhoni's glove which has disturbed the stumps. He waits there, the umpires have a chat and then go upstairs. Replays show that Marlon has been clean bowled. He walks back with a forlorn look on his face and Windies are in trouble here. Also replays show, maybe Samuels could have played it on the front foot. He was done in by the pace on that one as it was bowled a touch quicker.

Has Samuels been knocked over? Samuels does not feel so but Dhoni is pretty confident. They are going upstairs to check. Let me tell you, when Dhoni is confident, most of the times the batsman has to take the long walk back.
FOUR! Samuels is dealing in boundaries here. It is tossed up outside off, Marlon drives it square on the off side and the ball races away. He is cashing in on every delivery which is offered width.
Again it is floated up on off, Samuels blocks it out.
On the stumps, Samuels defends it out.

BEAUTY! Another tossed up googly around off, Samuels tries to go over the bowler's head but is beaten comprehensively. Dhoni again shows lightning speed to take the bails off. Rohit Sharma is again excited but Dhoni is not interested.

The googly from outside off, Marlon tries to keep it out with a lunge but is beaten. Dhoni is quick to whip the bails off but no appeal from him. Rohit though is excited but the umpire shakes his head.
On the stumps, kept out. Tidy start by Jadeja, 2 from his first.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Full and outside off, Samuels hits it through cover-point for a run.
Works it with the angle through square leg to get off strike.
On the pads, straightens a touch. Hope tries to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
Fires it on middle, kept out.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack now.
A dot to end an action-packed over! The leg spinner on middle, Samuels tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Once again Yadav pays the price of bowling it too full outside off, Samuels lunges and times it through covers. So two boundaries after the wicket and Samuels has a strike rate of 400.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Very full and outside off, Samuels times it through covers for a boundary.
Marlon Samuels strides out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! We did mention the real test begins now for the Windies and Hemraj has failed it. He has been knocked over by a brilliant googly. This is bowled slower through the air outside off, it pitches and comes back in. Hemraj fails to pick it, he tries to drive leaving a big gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and hits the middle pole. Kuldeep is up and running. Excellent change of bowling. A much-needed wicket as Hemraj was looking really good out there.

EDGY FOUR! Tossed up on off, it turns away. Hemraj prods forward and tries to drive but the ball takes an outside edge, goes past the slip fielder and into the third man fence. However, there were encouraging signs for the bowler as the ball did turn.
Slower through the air on middle, CH pushes it back to the bowler.
Kuldeep Yadav is into the attack. The real test for the Windies begins now.
Another classy drive but it is to the fielder at covers.
Slightly shorter in length on off, the batter pushes it to point.
Back of a length on off, Hope pushes it to mid off.

FOUR! Nicely played once again! Slight width on offer, Hope opens the face of the bat and guides it fine on the off side. It is very fine and the ball races away to the fence. Boundaries are flowing here.
A bumper on middle, Hope evades it.
Another stylish flick, this time by Hemraj towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Ends another over with a boundary does Shai Hope. Excellent over for Windies. 13 from it. Short and outside off, Hope is onto the back foot quickly and then punches it through point for a boundary. Windies off to a flier here.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it onto the ground.

BEAUTY! You just have to hope those miss your edges. On a length and around off, it pitches and then shapes away. Hope has to play at it due to the original angle but gets beaten by the away movement.
Another lovely shot! Short and on middle, CH pulls it through mid-wicket. A fielder in the deep means it is only a run.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Another ball just ahead of a length, Hemraj lofts it over the bowler's head and into the fence. That shot just shows that the ball is coming onto the bat nicely. 50 up for Windies.

FOUR! A slight misfield and a boundary! Full and around off, maybe it was not a good ball with third man up. Hemraj opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man. The fielder there dives over the ball and a boundary results.
FOUR! Hope has started in excellent fashion here. Full and outside off, Shai lunges and strokes it through wide mid off for a boundary. So a wicket to begin the over and a boundary to end it.
On a length around off, kept out.

WOW! How stylish was that? That shot had the Caribbean swag. Shortish on off, Hope with one foot up in the air, flicks it by using his wrists brilliantly, through backward square leg. The fielder from fine leg runs to his left, dives and saves a couple for his side.
Again in the 5th stump channel. Hope tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good delivery to bowl first up to the new batsman. In the corridor of uncertainty, Hope shoulders arms to it.
Shai Hope is the new man in.

OUT! A wicket falls. Powell departs and the crowd erupts in Vizag. The length from Shami is a bit on the shorter side around middle, Powell steps forward and tries to play the pick up shot across the line. He lifts it over mid-wicket but fails to generate enough timing or power behind his shot. Rishabh Pant in the deep makes no mistake. India draw first blood. Windies need 286 runs in 263 balls.
Pitches it up and on off, Chandrapaul drives it off his front foot but finds the mid off fielder.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! Slapped! Yadav overdoes his length and bowls it short and wide outside off, Hemraj remains inside the crease and slams it over point for a cracking boundary.

FOUR! Easily done. Yadav errs in his line and bowls a length ball on the leg stump line. Hemraj picks it off his pads and hits it firmly to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Both the Indian bowlers so far have been the culprits of bowling too straight on the pads.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Powell remains back and forces it down to long on for a run.
Mishit! A full length ball angling away from the batsman, Hemraj tries to drive but fails to middle his shot. It finds the inner half of his willow and rolls wide of mid on. They cross for a run.
Shortish and down the leg side, helped along to long leg with a little pull shot. A single to end the over.
Shami takes the pace off this delivery and bowls it on the pads of the batsman. Hemraj clips it on the leg side but the square leg fielder is quick to the ball. Another dot.
A length ball on middle and off, Hemraj defends it back from the crease.
Good length delivery outside off, Powell pushes at it and gets it away off the outside half of his bat. Finds Kuldeep again who fumbles once more. They cross for a run.
Shami digs in a short ball and Powell jumps out of the crease to play the pull shot. Doesn't get enough meat on his shot and it goes past the square leg fielder. A couple taken.

A length ball angling away from the batsman, Powell plays inside the line and tries to run it down to third man. However, he finds the fielder standing inside the ring. Kuldeep fumbles and parries it towards Dhoni, who turns with the ball thinking that the batsmen are attempting a run. Nothing of that sort happening and MS just keeps the ball with him.
On the pads and it's helped through square leg for a run. 10 from the over, Windies pressing forward.
Hits the yorker mark, on middle, Powell digs it out back in the direction of the bowler.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Powell picks the short delivery in a trice, once again stands back inside the crease and powers his pull shot in front of square leg for a boundary. Good start, this.

Streaky. The slip just moved out before this ball but it would not have carried anyway. Although, a run could have been stopped. Width on offer outside off, Hemraj throws his bat at it and gets it away off the bottom edge. It speeds past Dhoni to third man and they cross.
FOUR! This time Hemraj finds the gap. Yadav continues with his line on middle and serves it short. Hemraj whips it past the left side of the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Hemraj helps it on the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Shami goes short again with his length, it's outside off and sitting up nicely for the batsman to play the pull shot. Powell rides the bounce and nails his shot over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length delivery just around off, Powell sticks inside the crease and blocks it to the off side.
Drops it short and on middle, Hemraj does well to pull it behind square leg and gets off strike with a single.
Another delivery which has been bowled wide outside off, flirting with the tramline, Chandrapaul leaves it.
Sharp pace. In the channel outside off, Hemraj shoulders arms.

A nicely timed drive this time. Full and outside off, Hemraj drives but finds the point fielder. We have seen quite a few good shots but it has found the fielders inside the ring. Becomes frustrating for the batsmen.
Play and a miss! Too full in length and wide outside off, Powell tries to squeeze it out but is beaten for pace, probably. Good start from Umesh.
Lands it full and outside off, it's driven off the front foot but once again Powell fails to pierce the off side field. Finds the cover fielder.

A length ball angling across the batsman outside off, Kieran keeps his weight on the back foot and uses his hands to reach out for the ball. Ends up tapping it down on the off side. Not in the gap. Straight towards point.
Pitches it full and on off, angling away, Powell with minimum footwork drives through the line but finds mid off.
Kieran Powell is changing his bat.
Short and wide outside off, plenty of room on offer, Powell stands back and tries to slap it through the line. Fails to middle his shot properly and it rolls in front of point.
Starts with a shortish length ball on middle, Hemraj hits it across the line, through square leg and gets off strike.
Umesh Yadav to steam in from the other end with the second new ball. One slip stays...
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it safely. End of the first over, a decent beginning by the visiting team.
A bumper, around leg, Powell tries his best to hook it across the line but fails to connect. One for the over, signals the square leg umpire.
Another good length delivery which is straighter in line. Powell turns it on the leg side but finds the fielder standing in front of square leg.
FOUR! First boundary of the Windies innings. The line is once again too straight by Shami. It's served on a length and Powell flicks it nicely through square leg for a boundary.
This one is angling down the leg side, Hemraj nudges it fine down the leg side for a run.
Windies are away first ball! A good length delivery on middle, Powell stays back and forces it wide of mid on and mid-wicket. Before both the fielders run towards the ball, they cross for a run.

Back for the run chase. The men concerned are back on the field. Chandrapaul Hemraj and Kieran Powell are the openers for Windies. Mohammed Shami to kick off proceedings with the first new ball. India attacking with a slip. Here we go...
